acceptance: Invoke actual authenticated service routes and durable API or database readbacks; fail closed when any required service is absent.
Capture exact interaction, evidence, dataset version, handoff, acknowledgement, candidate, consultation request, and memo identifiers in one correlated result.
Verify duplicate/idempotency conflict behavior, acknowledgement ordering, tenant isolation, restart readback, failure-to-DLQ, and replay to successful terminal output.
Record safe write posture and prove unauthorized or disallowed writes fail without weakening strict authentication.
Record aggregate backlog counts before and after the test and never purge or bulk-acknowledge historical rows.
The verifier must return nonzero for a missing service, mismatched tenant, missing durable readback, unacknowledged handoff, missing candidate, or missing consultation memo.
Independent review must inspect the verifier source and raw evidence; owner-authored review_approved is invalid.
